notes.title: 1.0 Launch
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
Here’s the big update for the 1.0, and it’s packed with fixes, balancing, and of course… more cats! 🐾[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ New Content[/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]3 new cats[/b] (as always, every update brings more kitties!)[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Serenity World[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added the [i]Hide cinematics[/i] option in the in-game menu[/p][/*][*][p]Family bonus expanded: [b]from 9 to 27[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Hard mode now keeps the last difficulty taken[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐾 Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list][*][p]Paw item → deals less damage (especially the Black Panther one)[/p][/*][*][p]Attack speed increased on [i]Elastic[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Twig path → now grants more attack speed[/p][/*][*][p]Cat stick → deals more damage[/p][/*][*][p]Combs stay alive longer[/p][/*][*][p]Blue Razor Comb → deals more damage[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎵 Audio & Feedback[/h2][list][*][p]Faster music transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Music no longer changes during cinematics if they’re hidden[/p][/*][*][p]Sound of gems breaking now scales with distance (no more faraway noise)[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound when a chunk of boss HP is lost[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound when killing a boss[/p][/*][*][p]Better feedback when choosing a reward (controller + keyboard)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where growing bullets could grow bigger than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lag that could occur at the start of the first wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cat images in the challenge info[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loading screen not appearing after the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Catcoin UI missing the value of the last coin collected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement tab not showing how many bosses killed (per cat)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crabs & bosses still visible in the distance during loading[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gamepad buttons disappearing when clicking outside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos in French crab info[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “Titith” description in achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [i]Thief/Voleur [/i]→ now “Pilferer / Chapardeur”[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Meowligan's Crab: gives [b]3 rerolls[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated Cupicat's Crab: [b]catchable hearts 3 times[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Shot now blinks for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Unachieved Path” when picking up the item[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📊 Fun fact[/h2][p]The game now features [b]28 base weapons[/b], each evolving in several stages into [b]170 variants total[/b], including [b]71 final forms[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all the support and feedback! Every update has made the game cozier, cuter, and a little more chaotic.[/p][p]That has been an amazing year working with you on the game![/p]

notes.title: Kitty’s Last Adventure 1.0 will be available on August 26th!
notes.content: [p]Hey Cat Lovers![/p][p]The long wait is finally coming to an end, just a few more weeks to go![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Kitty’s Last Adventure 1.0[/b] will be available on [b]August 26th[/b]! [/h1][p][/p][p]Follow us to be the first to see everything that’s coming in the full version![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to play the close to 1.0 version, it's accessible for everyone under the beta branch![/p][p]1 => Open the properties of Kitty's Last Adventure in Steam[/p][p]2 => Click on "Beta"[/p][p]3 => Click on "None"[/p][p]4 => Click on "beta - beta of next update"[/p][p]The new achievements won't work, but launching the game after the update will allow you to receive them directly.[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/482545ac3bd7909fcae9c64e4cc36b7f87dbc5c1.png"][/img][/h1][h2]Change for the v0.9.0 version[/h2][list][*][p][b]MrPoop[/b] and [b]Stack of kibbles[/b] are now rendered under the monsters (so they don’t hide them).[/p][/*][*][p][b]CatStick[/b] and [b]Laser[/b] do more damage and have less attack speed (you can now one-shot the first monster with them! Way more satisfying!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hair[/b] and [b]HallowSock[/b] were not thrown correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Haunted Socks[/b] are more spread and deal more damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effect when hitting monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an info message when a wave starts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a path trail when the cat moves [i](can be disabled in settings)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Added info indicators for items to pick up [i](can be disabled in settings)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Hide Cinematics” option to the in-game menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Crab’s shadow now appears under the player instead of over them.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the selection in the codex menu more visible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a possible freeze during the very first wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loading screen sometimes not showing between menu and game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [i]very very rare[/i] bug where you could duplicate the waves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [i]very very rare[/i] bug where you could have the Odorion's crab bonus forever[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the delay for the steam achievements (or at least one of the reasons it could occur)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your support![/p]

notes.title: Cute Cups Update
notes.content:
This is the biggest patch since the release, I worked on many details that will improve everyone's experience while playing. [b]Without forgetting to add even more content![/b]

[h2]Not one, not two but THREE new cats[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/2dd2fd40b413cbb9f076f3b11568f0142df75a6a.png[/img]
I won't spoil everything on them, but I can't resist showing you the starting weapon of one of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/dfbd53c7cb571e3c496dae06592d5c088ef2b90d.png[/img]
[i]Yes, it's a weapon, and as you would imagine, it's in the damn cute family.[/i]

[h2]Cats can now break cups[/h2]
...as they do in real life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/827fab2da68fdd3864dbc7eb7be8c9025b7e5357.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Instead of the magnet lying around, they are now in cups that spawn at the start of each wave.
[*] They are easy to break and contain items you can already pick up in-game.
[*] For those used to chasing the permanent magnets it used to have around the start, they are still there, just in cups now.
[*] Catcoins that used to spawn on the ground are now in the cups
[*] Most hearts are still spawning outside of a cup, because, well, if you need hearts, I'm not sure you want to take the time to break the cup first!
[/list]

[h2]Controller shortcuts[/h2]
Moving in a menu with a controller is always a bit messy without shortcuts. Now it should make things smoother! You can now with a shortcut =>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/188c8149edc95afc3c5366882b58bfaf2bc5bc7c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Close popup
[*] Choose your upgrade
[*] Reroll
[*] show the codex
[*] Navigate between the different tabs in the main menu
[*] Access some elements in the different tabs with just a button
[/list]

[h2]Finally, Codex in-game![/h2]
The Codex was added to help people understand the weapon's paths. After implementing, you legitimately asked for it to be available in-game.  You can now access it when you level up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/bfd893bd321605df24ff26e3900755dcb170280c.gif[/img]
I also improved how the codex generally works:
[list]
[*] Codex shows the family
[*] Codex shows differently the items you finished or not (light yellow or full yellow)
[*] Items in the Codex are now grouped by families
[*] Automatically show the item you have selected
[*] Highlight (with blue selector) the choices you have in the current level up
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
I had to rework the whole achievement system on Steam.

[b]So don't be surprised when you'll launch the game that a lot of new achievements will trigger, it's mostly just changes on how I track achievements on Steam. Y[u]our progress in the game didn't change at all[/u].[/b]

I sadly couldn't have more than 100 achievements on Steam. It's a limitation most games have; you have to have it unlocked by Steam, and[b] there's nothing I can do to force it[/b].
I didn't know the existence of this limit, and my game has ALREADY more than 100 achievements in-game. Why that much, for example, [b]every cat has 5 achievements[/b]: unlocking, killing 3 bosses, finishing a normal game, finishing hard mode, and finishing bargaining.
[b]I packed most achievements in one for Steam[/b], for example, instead of having 1 achievement per cat for finishing a mode, I now have only one for every 5 cats finishing a mode.
I planned everything, and I should not remove any more achievements on Steam after this patch. But adding, for sure! [b]More cats and weapons are still coming![/b]

[b]I also improved the achievements tabs, it now shows more information about numeric achievements[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/d862400344374f8222e379cba24ad1785f3e95d5.gif[/img]

[h2]Change[/h2]
New family, Felin, (paw and hair are now Felin's family)

[h2]General improve[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a boss animation (every boss is now announced)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3be299dd82fb4610a6706ae6bf6fef73c3d06dea.gif[/img]
[*] The sparks around pick-up items are now all different to help identify which one it is.
[*] Catcoins now move like the other items
[*] Added some tips on the ground instead of the same message every game (only 6 for now, but more are coming!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/8deb72eb03812670a56e5a5f8cad7e94850f75e3.png[/img]
[*] Added image to better show what the bars are about (like a little cardbox for the cardbox bar)
[*] Reroll now removes the previous choices from the new selection. It's always annoying to use a reroll and have everything back. [i]Only works if you have more items available in the pool.[/i]
[*] Now, when killing a crab, you have a small explanation of what the bonus is about
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/ed377be3c2afd362abcd3ce21d40ff51d6dee468.gif[/img]
[*] Onomatopoeias have been added (can be turned off), like the "crack" + some actions now leave a mark on the world (like breaking a mug). [i]You can see an example of both on the above GIF when the cat breaks the mug.[/i]
[/list]


[h2]Bugs elimination[/h2]
[list]
[*] When using the controller, the wrong family could have the +1 in a rare case
[*] Bigger Hearts achievement's image was not correctly affiché (it had a typo since day one, I think haha)
[*] The bigger heart achievement was given too early
[*] The big laser now targets where the cat is aiming
[*] Fixed some achievements typo
[*] [UI] Added some padding in the cat descriptions so they don’t stick to the edge.
[*] One of the last evolutions of elastic was spawning the wrong color of elastic (one was blue instead of red)
[*] The big crab wasn't affected by the damage reduction
[/list]

Once again, thanks to everyone for playing Kitty's Last Adventure, commenting, and taking the time to give me feedback.

notes.title: Update 0.4.5 - New Cat !
notes.content:
[h2]🆕 Additions[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] New cat  
[*] 3 new basic weapons  
[*] Meta progression: Added 4 new levels for the bonus reroll
[/list]  

[h2]🔄 Changes[/h2]  
[list]
[*] The weapons of Kitty, Rocky, Tao, and Gyzmo now need to be unlocked by playing with these cats before becoming available for every cat (if you played with them already, they are already unlocked)
[*] Kittree is now unlocked after obtaining 8 cats, and Yeti takes its place at 6 cats.
[*] Unfortunately, I'm limited to 100 achievements on Steam, so I had to remove some to make room for new ones. If Steam allows me to exceed 100 in the future, everything will sync automatically—no worries!
[/list]  

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The crab that kept growing when picking up experience… it's gone! It didn't have the effect intended, it was pointless, so I removed it!
[*] Removed the message reminding you to use your Cat Coins when there’s nothing to buy!  
[/list]  

[h2]🔮 Upcoming Updates Info[/h2]  

[h3]📌 High Priority[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Family system update: I’d like to introduce new mechanics, such as evolutions that combine two families at the final stage.  
[*] More cats and weapons! 🐈⚔️  
[/list]  

[h3]⏳ Later On[/h3]  
Difficulty modes are still on my to-do list. As I mentioned before, I don’t just want to increase enemy stats but rather bring some fresh gameplay changes!  

Thank you again for your feedback and support!

notes.title: What to expect next?
notes.content:
It’s hard to believe it’s been only 3 months since the release! The pace has been intense, and here’s a quick recap of what’s been added so far:

[list]
[*] [b]Quality of Life improvements[/b], including a revamped level-up screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3b64c6612bb6a7f976e2ec258357f2465b6eeeaf.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Balancing adjustments[/b], such as the update to the normal world boss.
[*] [b]The Codex has been introduced[/b], making it easier to understand how the weapon works.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3ed012be34b1f962e70622252f8c45a71bb8cc28.gif[/img]
[*] [b]A brand-new world[/b] with a fresh system and replayability for the cats already in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/bb3a5adb0477d43df0f5ab9d7faf8b010007b6fd.gif[/img]
[*] 3 new cats, bringing the total number of weapons to 11, with 28 final evolutions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/91f9228dc3879734d076eb3e5bf2ae8a0d8515eb.png[/img]
[/list]
The feedback has been incredibly positive, and I want to thank you all for your support during Early Access. There’s still a lot of work ahead, with the next focus being adding more cats and weapons!

[h2]Next update[/h2]
The upcoming Christmas-themed update will introduce a new cat Kittree.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/6360728dc31b3fc7042561e1eacb76079d155416.gif[/img]


[h2]What’s next? Here’s a glimpse:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]More classic cats[/b]—some of which are already designed! The ratio of special cats to classic ones is a bit unbalanced right now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/eb00d534eafb5d92e3a70fc38d181b1805d3ce94.png[/img]
[*] [b]New weapons without new cats[/b], simply increasing the total weapon pool in the game.
[*] [b]Improving the early game[/b] by making weapons from the first three unlockable cats available earlier. This way, while discovering and testing new cats, you’ll also have the chance to try weapons you haven’t unlocked yet! Noxy is the first new weapon you can currently unlock, and it’s only available after finishing the game!
[*] [b]Meta progression[/b]: Adding levels to existing options or introducing entirely new ones.
[*] [b]New difficulty levels[/b] with more exciting options. The goal is to introduce more variety in runs (boss waves, new enemies, etc.). Currently limited to 5, but eventually, it will go up to 15, unlocking the final world: Serenity.
[*] [b]More QoL improvements and balancing[/b], including the addition of the Codex in-level and changes to weapon families!
[/list]

There’s so much more to come, and I appreciate you being part of this journey. Stay tuned, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Final World Boss Update
notes.content:
In this update, I’ve made significant changes to the final boss fight to make the progression clearer and more enjoyable, while also adjusting the balance.

Main changes:

[h1]Damage mechanic rework[/h1]
The boss is now invulnerable at the start of the fight. His health is no longer tied to the objects he protects. He will appear invulnerable, without a health bar, and your shots won’t affect him until the objects are destroyed. Once the objects are eliminated, he becomes vulnerable, with a white health bar indicating that he can be attacked.

[h1]Improved readability and difficulty[/h1]
The boss will only drool during the final phase of the fight, making this stage less punishing but still challenging. He will be more aggressive by changing direction more frequently and slowing down before attacking at the end of his rushes.

[h1]New final health bar[/h1]
The boss's final health bar has been increased to provide better feedback during the vulnerability phase. You’ll see your attacks' impact more clearly, preventing frustration from an overly abrupt ending.

Thank you to all the streamers and players for your feedback and suggestions!

[i]The next content update will be released in less than two weeks, featuring new cats, weapons, and meta-progression![/i]
